Title: What We Whispered and What We Screamed
Source Situation / Theme: Shawn attacks Tara in front of Charles; shame drives her to deny what happened and the relationship collapses.
Design Extraction: Witnessing does not automatically produce disclosure or rescue. Shame can make a person protect the very story that harms them.
Game Transformation: Design a one-time safety-centered scene where the player can escape, call for help, minimize, disclose, or say nothing, with no perfect outcome.
Guardrail: No repeatable abuse, spectacle, QTE mastery, or reward for enduring harm.

Title: I'm from Idaho
Source Situation / Theme: Tara begins honest meetings with a bishop, faces dental and financial crisis, receives help, and becomes less alone.
Design Extraction: Institutions become usable through specific people, forms, and acts of trust—not through abstract conversion.
Game Transformation: Create a confidential support chain involving Rev. Hale, a grant application, clinic care, and choices about how much to disclose.
Guardrail: Confidentiality has limits and must be explained clearly to the player.

Title: A Knight, Errant
Source Situation / Theme: Psychology and historical research lead Tara to question her father's mental health story and the version of Ruby Ridge she inherited; she experiments with ordinary life.
Design Extraction: Research can reframe a family legend without reducing a person to a diagnosis.
Game Transformation: Use an archive investigation that compares lectures, newspapers, public records, and family testimony while preserving uncertainty.
Guardrail: Do not diagnose Abel as a gameplay fact; focus on patterns, evidence, and impact.

Title: The Work of Sulphur
Source Situation / Theme: Tara's father is catastrophically burned in a fuel explosion and the family cares for him at home as he slowly survives.
Design Extraction: A crisis can show extraordinary love and competence while exposing the cost of refusing help.
Game Transformation: Create a large, non-repeatable industrial emergency followed by days of resource management, caregiving, and difficult medical choices.
Guardrail: No graphic fetish, miracle score, or implication that suffering proves faith.

Title: Waiting for Moving Water
Source Situation / Theme: During recovery Tara speaks more openly with her father; Shawn becomes engaged to Emily; Tara tries to warn her and ends a relationship she cannot enter honestly.
Design Extraction: A temporary opening can coexist with a repeating danger. Telling the truth may fail, but silence also has a cost.
Game Transformation: Pair bedside caregiving conversations with a private warning mission and an intimacy choice shaped by Mara's ability to disclose.
Guardrail: The person being warned retains agency; the player cannot 'save' them through one perfect line.

Title: If I Were a Woman
Source Situation / Theme: Tara changes from music to history, politics, and geography, tells a professor about her background, and is encouraged toward Cambridge.
Design Extraction: Choosing what to study is also choosing what kinds of questions one is permitted to ask.
Game Transformation: Let the player reshape Mara's capability tree through disciplines and mentors rather than fixed gendered classes.
Guardrail: Avoid treating artistic study as lesser than academic study; both remain valid paths.

Title: Pygmalion
Source Situation / Theme: At Cambridge, Tara feels out of place until a mentor recognizes that skills from her past can be strengths rather than signs of inferiority.
Design Extraction: Mentorship can change self-perception by accurately naming ability, not by inventing a new person.
Game Transformation: Use a study-abroad hub where practical traversal, close observation, and archival reasoning unexpectedly matter.
Guardrail: Do not turn elite education into a magical cure; belonging remains contested.

Title: Graduation
Source Situation / Theme: Tara wins a Cambridge scholarship, graduates from BYU, faces family resentment over how she tells her story, and leaves for England.
Design Extraction: Achievement can increase both freedom and family tension; public storytelling raises questions of ownership.
Game Transformation: Combine application, interview, ceremony, family visit, and airport departure into a threshold chapter with several truth-telling choices.
Guardrail: Do not imply academic recognition resolves trauma or family conflict.

Title: Hand of the Almighty
Source Situation / Theme: At Cambridge, coffee, vaccination, and feminist thought become signs that Tara is choosing her own body and intellectual life.
Design Extraction: Transformation may appear through ordinary acts that would once have felt forbidden.
Game Transformation: Let optional daily choices—health care, reading groups, food, friendship—gradually alter worldview clarity and social access.
Guardrail: Do not treat any single lifestyle choice as a morality badge.

Title: Tragedy Then Farce
Source Situation / Theme: A tea-set moment helps Tara see that Audrey may share her history; Audrey later confirms abuse and asks Tara to stand with her.
Design Extraction: An ordinary object can unlock a buried pattern, and shared memory can create a fragile alliance.
Game Transformation: Use an object-triggered memory scene followed by delayed correspondence that asks the player to commit to a joint account.
Guardrail: Shared memory remains partial; one sibling's account does not automatically overwrite another's.

Title: A Brawling Woman in a Wide House
Source Situation / Theme: A grandmother is dying; the family business has grown; the mother's confidence rises while the father's grief and anger deepen.
Design Extraction: Economic power can rearrange a household without automatically producing truth or safety.
Game Transformation: Return the player to a transformed compound with employees, schedules, money, caregiving, and new conflicts over authority.
Guardrail: Growth is not shown as proof that the family's worldview is correct.

Title: Sorcery of Physics
Source Situation / Theme: Audrey asks Tara not to leave; Tara returns to Cambridge, builds a scholarly and romantic life, while Shawn threatens Audrey.
Design Extraction: The player may be unable to protect another person and preserve their own fragile escape at the same time.
Game Transformation: Create simultaneous objectives in two regions, using messages and incomplete information to force a boundary decision.
Guardrail: Do not frame self-preservation as selfish failure or staying as heroic certainty.

Title: The Substance of Things
Source Situation / Theme: Tara tells her parents about Shawn's abuse; they demand proof and summon him; a bloody knife and a dead dog reveal danger, and she retracts under pressure.
Design Extraction: Truth-telling does not guarantee belief, and evidence may be weaponized inside a power structure.
Game Transformation: Design a controlled high-stakes dialogue with readable exits, a safety pause, and outcomes based on preparation and allies—not a perfect speech.
Guardrail: Mandatory sensitivity review; no graphic violence; never trap the player without an exit or content controls.

Title: West of the Sun
Source Situation / Theme: Back at Cambridge, threats and family denial make Tara distrust her own memories; Audrey withdraws support.
Design Extraction: Coordinated denial can damage confidence in memory even when external evidence remains.
Game Transformation: Let the journal retain prior observations while conclusions become unstable; trusted witnesses can validate facts without dictating meaning.
Guardrail: Do not use 'unreliable narrator' as a twist that erases abuse.
